title: An error occurred trying to install this update   (to version 0.98.0)

judgment.rationale: The reporter states that a later update notification installed 0.99.1 successfully. No continuing failure remains in the latest evidence, so a competing installer proposal is not justified.
evidence: The initial report includes an update log from an unsuccessful attempt to install 0.98.0.
The last comment says a later notification successfully installed 0.99.1.
The issue does not provide a new failure after that successful installation.
judgment.recommended_action: No new implementation action unless the update failure recurs with a fresh current log.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported upgrade path is no longer failing according to the reporter’s last update. A code fix is not applicable without a current recurrence.

issue_context.known_information: The original report included an update log for an attempted 0.98.0 update; another commenter described a similar 0.99 update failure.
issue_context.inferences: The last reporter comment may indicate a transient updater/network condition rather than a persistent installer defect.

issue_context.initial_investigation: Read the full issue and both comments, including the 2026-05-01 resolution update. No distinct linked covering fix is established.
